subject: [PATCH v4 10/14] NFSD: stop registering with rpcbind after a failure in listener_set

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch addresses a performance issue in the NFSD code by stopping registration with rpcbind after a failure in listener_set. The current implementation calls svc_xprt_create_from_sa() for each requested listener, which can lead to multiple registrations with rpcbind and subsequent timeouts. To mitigate this, the patch reads the rpcb_failure_count before creating listeners and skips registering with rpcbind if it has failed previously. This approach reduces the likelihood of prolonged lock contention on nfsd_mutex.
